title: CVE card vocabulary (P182 cisa_kev, P183 cve_record, P184 epss/epss_api)
notes: Facts the CVE modules add to the one consolidated CVE card with provenance (P183 cond 5). 'kev' (core) stays CISA-only; every other exploitation evidence goes to 'exploited' (P182 cond 4, P181 cond 3).

attributes.kev_date_added: ISO date the CVE was added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalogue
attributes.kev_due_date: ISO remediation due date CISA set for U.S. federal agencies in the KEV catalogue (BOD 22-01)
attributes.kev_vendor: vendor/project named by the CISA KEV entry
attributes.kev_product: product named by the CISA KEV entry
attributes.kev_vulnerability_name: vulnerability name of the CISA KEV entry
attributes.kev_description: short description of the CISA KEV entry
attributes.kev_required_action: required action text of the CISA KEV entry
attributes.kev_ransomware_use: CISA KEV knownRansomwareCampaignUse value as published ('Known' or 'Unknown')
attributes.kev_ransomware_known: bool: CISA KEV says the CVE is known to be used in ransomware campaigns (shown as its own flag)
attributes.kev_forensic_triage: bool: the CISA KEV entry carries a forensic triage requirement (forensicTriage 'Yes')
attributes.kev_references: list of reference URLs from the notes of the CISA KEV entry (vendor advisories, directives)
attributes.kev_catalog_version: catalogVersion of the local CISA KEV copy that answered
attributes.kev_status: plain-words CISA KEV status: listed (since, due date, ransomware use) or 'not in CISA KEV', which is never evidence of non-exploitation
attributes.kev_search_hits: list of {cve, vendor, product, name, date_added, ransomware_use} of the local CISA KEV catalogue matching a keyword (newest first)
attributes.cve_state: CVE record state: PUBLISHED, REJECTED or RESERVED (REJECTED/RESERVED records are informational, never scored)
attributes.cve_title: title of the CVE record (CNA container)
attributes.cve_description: English description of the CVE record
attributes.cve_published: ISO date the CVE record was published
attributes.cve_assigner: short name of the CVE Numbering Authority that assigned the id
attributes.cve_rejected_reason: reason given by the CNA for a REJECTED CVE record
attributes.cve_replaced_by: list of CVE ids that replace a REJECTED record
attributes.cve_matches: list of {cve, cvss, published, state} of CVE records matching a keyword (NVD keywordSearch, key 'nvd' only)
attributes.cvss_scores: list of CVSS scores with provenance {source, version, score, severity, vector} (CNA, CISA-ADP, NVD...)
attributes.cwe: CWE weakness id(s) of a CVE
attributes.cwe_names: list of CWE labels from the registered CWE catalogue (e.g. 'CWE-502 Deserialization of Untrusted Data')
attributes.ssvc: CISA SSVC decision points {exploitation: none|poc|active, automatable, technical_impact, source, date}
attributes.exploited: dict source -> first date of exploitation evidence outside CISA KEV (CISA-ADP SSVC 'active', CIRCL sightings, VulnCheck, MSRC, EUVD)
attributes.exploit_refs: list of curated exploit/PoC reference URLs (CNA 'exploit' tag, NVD 'Exploit' tag); links only, never fetched
attributes.exploit_count: int: number of curated exploit/PoC references
attributes.vendor_advisories: list of vendor advisory / patch / mitigation reference URLs
attributes.fixed_versions: list of {product, fixed} versions that fix the vulnerability (CNA unaffected changes, lessThan bounds, NVD versionEndExcluding)
attributes.affected: list of affected products {vendor, product, versions, fixed} from the CVE record
attributes.cpe_matches: list of NVD vulnerable CPE criteria with version ranges {criteria, vendor, product, version, start/end bounds, running_on}
attributes.cpe_total: int: number of vulnerable CPE criteria NVD lists (cpes/cpe_matches are capped)
attributes.nvd_status: NVD vulnStatus of the CVE (Analyzed, Awaiting Analysis, Modified, Rejected...)
attributes.data_notices: list of notices the providers of these facts require wherever their data appears (e.g. the NVD API notice)
attributes.epss_percentile: EPSS percentile (0-1) of the CVE among all scored CVEs
attributes.epss_date: ISO date of the EPSS model run the score comes from
attributes.epss_model_version: EPSS model version of the score (e.g. 'v2026.06.15'; a model change shifts every score)
attributes.epss_text: plain-words EPSS line, e.g. 'EPSS 0.94 (top 1%): likely to be exploited soon'
